title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 41-44 (Padmapriya, Padmahasta, Padmakshi, Padmasundari)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 41 to 44: Padmapriya, Padmahasta, Padmakshi, Padmasundari, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 41 to 44 with meaning
caption: Names 41 to 44 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 41 to 44**: **Padmapriya, Padmahasta, Padmakshi, Padmasundari**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Padmapriya, Padmahasta, Padmakshi, Padmasundari.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Padmapriya** means **Fond of the lotus**. Lotus flowers are the most loved offering to Lakshmi.
**Padmahasta** means **Lotus in hand**. The lotus grows in mud yet stays pure, a reminder to stay humble and clean in wealth.
**Padmakshi** means **Lotus-eyed**. Large, gentle eyes like lotus petals: a sign of compassion.
**Padmasundari** means **Beautiful as a lotus**. Lakshmi is shown as ideal beauty: graceful and calm.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
